card.name: Names of state government agencies
card.fires_on: The word right after a US state or Australian state name that starts a government body, such as Department, Dept, Secretary or .gov. It also fires inside all-caps DEPARTMENT.

modes.label: Department after state
modes.description: Department or Dept right after a state name, in the title of a state agency.
modes.example: New York<< Department>> of Environmental Conservation (DEC) Commissioner Joe

modes.label: All-caps DEPARTMENT
modes.description: The middle of DEPARTMENT in an all-caps agency heading.

modes.label: Other state-linked words
modes.description: A word after a state or territory name that continues a government name or web address.

card.plain: It spots the point in a text where a state name is followed by the word for a government agency, like Department of Health.
